## APMG Campaign Send

POST /webhook/campaign-send (Header Auth: x-apmg-secret)

Body: { campaign, messages: [{ to, leadId, subject, text, attachment?, hero?, hero_alt? }] }

**PLAIN TEXT.** Cold emails go out as text/plain, not branded HTML — the
sending domain has no warm-up history and an image-heavy HTML blast is a poor
first impression to a spam filter. The Gmail node MUST stay on emailType
`text` with message `{{ $json.text }}`. Switching it back to `html` renders
the body as one unbroken wall with no line breaks.

`hero`/`hero_alt` are still sent by the app and deliberately IGNORED.

**Sector playbook** is LINKED through the /t/ hook, never attached.

**Portal host**: every URL in the message body is normalised onto
`https://customer.apmgservices.com.au` by `canonicalUrl()` in Split Messages
before send. The app bakes NEXT_PUBLIC_TRACK_BASE in at BUILD time, so a stale
host can survive an env var change until a redeploy. Add any retired host to
LEGACY_PORTAL_HOSTS.

**Unsubscribe** (Spam Act 2003) always renders when there is a base + a
recipient address.
